$extensions.source: Measured computed font-family of the corporate.walmart.com h1 ('Everyday Sans Headline', 60px, weight 900). Separate site. Proprietary.

Measured --font-weight-700. Departments, h1, h2, price, EN button.
Measured home h1 'Walmart | Save Money. Live better.': 32px / 700. The heading is visually hidden (width 1px). Line-height was the keyword normal; 36px is the measured height of that h1.
Measured home h2 'Discover great brands': 24px / 700 / 30px. Price dollars are the same 24px / 700.

Measured body font-size 16px. Product title span: 16px / 400. --ld-semantic-font-body-medium-size is 1rem (16px) and line-height 1.5rem (24px). The product title computed line-height was normal; 20px is the measured line box of a title span.
Measured Departments button: 14px / 700 / 17.5px. Pharmacy chip is 14px / 400.
Measured home subhead: 14px / 400 / color rgb(116, 118, 124). --ld-semantic-font-body-small-size is 0.875rem.
Measured price dollars span: 24px / 700 / height 28px. The dollar sign and cents are 14px / 700.
Measured corporate.walmart.com h1: 60px / 900 / 76px / white. Weight 900 has no core step; the token records bold and the source names 900. Separate site, 10px root.
